title: MessageBus: announces that a kept list changed (Publish ListChanged, scoped to one list, at-most-once, best-effort, non-fatal to the kept action)

ListRef.description: Opaque reference to one kept list, as resolved upstream by KeptListManager via CallerAccess. Scopes every announcement to exactly that list; a notice is never delivered to another list's views.

ListChanged.description: Notice, published by KeptListManager as the last step of every changing use case after the change is durably kept, that a kept list changed. Deliberately minimal: names the list only (no titles, done state or counts) so it cannot leak todo content; receivers re-read through the normal review path. Publish with no subscribers is a successful no-op; slow or absent subscribers never delay or fail Publish; delivery is at-most-once, best-effort, no persistence or replay; a duplicate only causes a redundant re-read. Publish returns an error only when the notice cannot be handed to the transport (empty listRef, transport closed); the caller treats it as non-fatal to the already-kept list action.
